prompt_suffix: Answer the question using a single word or phrase.
preprocessing: Original RGB and official LLaVA pad-to-square mean background, CLIP processor 336; no external OCR.

scorer.rules: Official answer substring match: HME100k strips spaces and newlines case-sensitively; other datasets lowercase, strip outer whitespace and replace newline with space. Any accepted answer gives one point.
scorer.scale: Raw summed score 0–1000, not a percentage or VQA soft score.
